name: Crowd Arcade
summary: Crowd Arcade is a live-streamed multiplayer arcade controlled entirely by Twitch viewers. A headless authoritative simulation runs several games on a scheduled rotation: a physics-based coin pusher, a fishing pond, a PvP arena, a runner, a siege defense and a grenade-throwing artillery game. Viewers play for free through channel point rewards and chat commands, and earn cosmetic items for their avatar. There are no real-money prizes.
